_meta.purpose: DAS nevents of the central RunIII2024Summer24 NanoAODv15 datasets of the 7 ttbar stitching samples, used by scripts/aggregate_validation.py as the completeness criterion (the sum of per-chunk nano_entries must equal this).
_meta.why_in_this_repo: A validation tool carries its own reference data (docs/08 T-23 (7), docs/04 D16).
_meta.source: NtupleForge script/das/das_ttHH_2024_v15_20260923_0851.log (sha256[:16] 5a4f4abeb574308d), DS| lines; the same numbers are in script/das/inventory_dumps/das_inventory_summer24_v15_20260911_0427.tsv (sha256[:16] 9cf83f0dc7a5c7eb). The datasets are the ones TTHHAnalyzer data/samples_2024.json uses.
_meta.keys: Validation short sample names (same as filelists/nano2024/filelist_<short>.txt); the Run 3 primaries map to them (TT4B -> tt4b, TTBBto4Q -> ttbb_Hadronic, ...)
_meta.nano_files: 34 / 189 / 283 / 203 / 773 / 790 / 780 files (same order as datasets), 3,052 in total
_meta.miniaod: The extend rows are judged against the MiniAODv6 nevents by the manager; NanoAOD may hold fewer events than its MiniAOD parent (it did for five UL16 entries). Extend-only events are not a validation failure.
_meta.update_rule: Only change these if the DAS dataset itself changes. A mismatch against a validation run means the run is INCOMPLETE -- do not 'fix' it by editing this file.
